also: wait for the light to change

phrases.english: “Why are we stopping?” “Because the light is red.”

phrases.latin: Ad sēmaphorum cōnsistimus, dum viride fīat.
phrases.english: We stop at the lights until they turn green.

phrases.latin: Ecce, viride est; jam pergere licet.
phrases.english: Look, it’s green; now we can go.

phrases.latin: Manē, dum viride fīat; tum trānsībimus.
phrases.english: Wait for the green light; then we’ll cross.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 219, 397.
